data.title: Interior Ministry Delegation Takes Part in 15th INTERPA Conference in Qatar
data.content:
Doha, November 19, 2026, SPA -- Acting Director General of King Fahd Security College and Vice President of the International Association of Police Academies (INTERPA) Dr. Fahad Alwatban led the Ministry of Interior’s delegation at the 15th INTERPA Conference, hosted by the Qatari Police Academy in Doha.
    The meeting brought together police training leaders and experts from around the world to strengthen international cooperation, exchange institutional expertise, and advance security education and training.
    Sessions focused on strategic knowledge governance, the use of emerging technologies in security operations, data protection, and updating academic curricula to keep pace with digital transformation and evolving security requirements.
    -- SPA
